raw_abilities: Overall Skill Level : Akari is a non-combatant type of sorcerer, having enrolled in  Kyoto Jujutsu High  as an assistant manager. She is only capable of barely seeing  cursed spirits , and may have received minimal combat training, [ 6 ]  although one kick from  Haruta Shigemo  was enough to deal significant damage to her, leaving her  motionless for several minutes, before ultimately escaping.

Overall Abilities : The Angel was a notable sorcerer during the Heian Era, the golden age of jujutsu, and served as part of the  Abe Clan 's elite force, though she and her comrades were eventually defeated by Sukuna wielding his two signature cursed tools. [ 17 ]  Still, due to her experience and holding an  innate technique  that counters any and all jujutsu without prejudice, the Angel is a formidable force. She is fatally dangerous to fellow incarnated sorcerers who (being cursed objects fused with living flesh) are susceptible to her technique. [ 3 ] The Angel's capabilities are made evident through Hana who, despite being a young girl with no formal sorcerer training, was sufficiently empowered by the ancient sorcerer to easily survive the Culling Game, wherein the Angel's ability made her the only player capable of crossing Colony borders freely. [ 35 ] [ 36 ]  Ultimately, Hana cast " Jacob's Ladder " to nearly succeed in purging Sukuna, albeit the King of Curses had not yet achieved a strong hold over his new host, Megumi, nor was he at full strength. Hana failed to eliminate the Disgraced One only because he exploited the girl's love for Megumi to fool her into deactivating her technique halfway through casting it. [ 37 ]  Later, the Angel's and Hana's greatest contribution to their sorcerer allies would be when they used Jacob's Ladder on the " Back " of the  Prison Realm , unsealing Satoru Gojo. [ 38 ] Incarnation  ( 受  ( じゅ )  肉  ( にく )  ,   Juniku ? ) : Like many past sorcerers, the Angel struck a  deal  with Kenjaku to effectively bind her soul to a cursed object, allowing her to incarnate post-mortem and possess Hana. Unlike most incarnates, the Angel has formed a symbiotic relationship that leaves Hana in control of her body, with the Angel able to speak by manifesting a second mouth on the girl's body, usually her cheek or hand (much like Sukuna could while inhabiting Yuji). However, this condition leaves the Angel unable to physically interfere in the event that Hana takes a fatal misstep during combat. [ 3 ] [ 39 ] [ 40 ]  Moreover, unlike Sukuna, the Angel cannot switch hosts, lacking the King of Curse's knowledge on how to divide her own soul. [ 18 ] Flight : While possessing Hana, the Angel grants her the ability to levitate and fly. [ 2 ] Great Intellect : The Angel has repeatedly proven herself to be shrewd, perceptive, and knowledgeable on jujutsu, which has made her a major asset to her and Hana's present-day allies. She immediately inferred that Megumi and Yuji, claiming to have sought her out, must have learned of her technique and then used that as leverage to gain her newfound allies' favor and (seeming) willingness to aid her in her goal: killing Sukuna. [ 6 ]  When the first Tokyo Colony was flooded with over a thousand foreigners of non-sorcerer status, the Angel correctly ascertained that the responsible party was Kenjaku, who was seeking a fail-safe in case the Culling Game players do not sufficiently raise the Colonies' ambient cursed energy (for the ritual to merge Tengen with Japan's populace). [ 7 ] [ 41 ] Perhaps most impressively, the Angel was the only one to realize the true nature and potential of Takaba's  innate technique , despite the man's unassuming, frivolous demeanor. She initially realized that it may have helped Hana survive Sukuna [ 42 ]  and later recommended that Takaba be sent after Kenjaku. [ 12 ]  Otherwise, the Angel's jujutsu knowledge extends to the workings of  Domain Amplification , the dynamics involved in a  domain  clash, and the potential recovery of a burnt-out technique using  Reverse Cursed Technique . [ 29 ] [ 30 ] [ 31 ] Innate Technique 
 
 
 
 
 Technique Extinguishment  ( 術  ( じゅつ )  式  ( しき )  の 消  ( しょう )  滅  ( めつ )  ,   Jutsushiki no Shōmetsu ? ) : [ 43 ]  The Angel's technique, inherited by Hana, allows for the "extinguishment"  ( 消滅 ,   shōmetsu ? )  of any and all other cursed techniques, negating them. Barriers, seals, and cursed objects alike are susceptible, including  special grades  like the Prison Realm. However, the Angel admits that it is nearly impossible for her to split incarnated sorcerers from their hosts without killing both, as incarnations are fusions of cursed objects with living flesh. [ 2 ] [ 44 ] Maximum Output: Jacob's Ladder  ( 出  ( しゅつ )  力  ( りょく )  最  ( さい )  大  ( だい )  「 邪  ( や )  去  ( こ )  悔  ( ぶ )  の 梯  ( はし )  子  ( ご )  」 ,   Shutsuryoku Saidai: Yakobu no Hashigo ? ) : An  extension technique  through which the Angel conjures a four-winged trumpet made of light in her hands, then an immense circle of light in the sky above her. Said circle resembles a magic array and features a heptagram in its middle, plus several crosses along its periphery. By sounding the trumpet, a pillar of light descends from middle of the circle to engulf whatever is below. Thus, any curse will be "extinguished" under the light of Jacob's Ladder. [ 37 ] [ 38 ]

Overall Skill Level : Todo is an exceptionally powerful sorcerer, undoubtedly one of Jujutsu High's strongest students. He obtained the rank of a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer as a student despite coming from a non-sorcerer family. Todo single-handedly defeated five grade 1 cursed spirits and 1 special grade during the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons in Kyoto, having only used his cursed technique to defeat the special grade. This feat became well known around the jujutsu community and caused the rumor that Todo defeated all six curses without his cursed technique. [ 12 ] Todo possesses physical strength that surpasses Maki and  Panda 's, rivalling Yuji's prowess. Using brute force and fierce martial arts, Todo was able to easily overwhelm Megumi as well as pummel Yuji in the early stages of their bout. Even after beginning to guide Yuji on how to become stronger, Todo maintained the upper hand while fighting due to his experience and cleverness. Todo and Yuji turned out to be a good match and Todo showcased his intelligence and knowledge surrounding jujutsu sorcery and battles. Aoi's understanding of cursed energy allowed him to teach Yuji how to properly use it alongside his superhuman speed and strength. While fighting alongside Yuji, Todo was very nearly able to defeat Hanami, one of the most powerful special grade cursed spirits to have appeared. During the heat of  battle  against Hanami, Todo was able to analyze all their moves and instantly create ways to counter them using his own cursed technique. Hanami initially analyzed Todo to be weaker than them, but the careful planning and precise teamwork with Yuji allowed Todo to dominate the fight. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Todo prefers close quarters combat to anything else, normally relying on brute force to overpower his opponents rather than jujutsu. He completely outclassed Megumi when trading blows, easily able to outmaneuver and brutalize the first year at every turn. Even against Yuji, who's extremely talented in hand to hand fight, Todo was able to effortlessly overpower at the start of their fight. Even as the fight went on and Yuji began to adapt to Todo's moves, he was still able to surprise Yuji and stay one step ahead thanks to his combat experience. He generally employs a mix of direct and crushing blows such as punches, forearm smashes, stomps and other brutal strikes. This type of fighting was effective against Hanami, mainly while being used alongside his cursed technique. Enhanced Strength : Against most opponents, Todo is more than capable of relying on raw physicality to win fights. A single strike against Megumi was able to send him reeling back several meters. His fighting style includes a barrage of powerful blows, stomps, and suplexes in quick succession. A cursed energy infused strike from Todo is capable of obliterating a lower grade curse completely while still damaging Yuji, his intended target before the curse suddenly inhibited his punch. Alongside Yuji's enhanced punches, Todo was able to hit Hanami's guard hard enough for the special grade to acknowledge the weight of the hit. Combined with his cursed technique, Todo's strength becomes even more difficult to deal with. It allows him to exploit openings in his opponent's defense which allows him to land lethal strikes using his physical strength. Using  Boogie Woogie  to switch out his partner for a special grade  cursed tool , Todo delivered a strike so powerful it shattered Hanami's weak point, the branches growing out of their face, in a single blow. A hit so strong, Todo believed it should have ended the fight altogether. The cursed tool,  Playful Cloud  relies on the strength of its user, further cementing Todo's near-superhuman levels of physical power. Enhanced Speed : To match his incredible strength Todo possesses extreme speed. He incorporates his frightening speed in his fighting style by continuously striking with quick succession before his opponents can react. He blitzed clean through Megumi's every defense in their fight and landed blow after blow to overpower him. At the very beginning of the Goodwill Event, it took Todo just a few seconds to reach the opposing team. He was even able to surprise Yuji with his speed and momentarily overpower him with sheer physical prowess. Todo's speed also allows him to move unpredictably when utilizing his cursed technique, as shown while fighting Hanami. Great Tactical Intellect : Todo's oafish demeanor fools most people, but he's actually incredibly intelligent; claiming to have an IQ of 530,000. [ 18 ]  While this is exaggerated, by using his own experience and vast understanding of jujutsu, he was able to transform Yuji from a sub-par jujutsu sorcerer to a fighter capable of taking on special grade cursed spirits. Todo even has a deeper philosophical side that was able to help Yuji grasp the understanding of jujutsu. [ 19 ] Cursed Energy Manipulation : Todo understands the essence of cursed energy and possesses masterful control over it. He understands the nature of how to make cursed energy effectively flow throughout his entire body, allowing him to freely manipulate it as a part of his close combat arsenal and making his flow of energy difficult to read. He is sufficiently knowledgeable in this aspect of cursed energy that he can teach it to others. [ 20 ] Cursed Energy Reinforcement : Todo has a good understanding of how to utilize cursed energy to reinforce his body. He is able to strengthen his punches enough to obliterate low-grade curses in a single punch [ 21 ]  and can infuse his energy into cursed tools. [ 22 ]  For defense, Todo can also apply a coating of cursed energy to his body to protect himself from attacks. [ 23 ] Black Flash  ( 黒  ( こく )  閃  ( せん )  ,   Kokusen ? ) : A phenomenon that creates a spatial distortion when a user connects an impact of cursed energy within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit, causing cursed energy to flash black, creating a more potent attack to the power of 2.5 of a normal hit. Todo first used Black Flash when him and Yuji fought Mahito during the Shibuya Incident. [ 24 ]  Currently, he has performed it once. Binding Vows 
 
 
 
 Revealing One's Hand  ( 情  ( じょう )  報  ( ほう )  の 開  ( かい )  示  ( じ )  ,   Jōhō no Kaiji ? ) : A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how his cursed technique works, Todo increases the effectiveness of his technique as well as mislead his opponents on how it works. Innate Technique 
 
 
 
 
 Boogie Woogie  ( 不義遊戯  ( ブギウギ )  ,   Bugi Ugi ? ) : Todo's innate technique allows him to switch the positions of anything with cursed energy within his range with a clap of his hands. [ 25 ] [ 26 ]  He can change himself out with the location of another person, or switch two different parties other than himself as well. [ 27 ]  Though a clap is required to trigger the ability, he does not have to clap  both  of his hands specifically, as Todo is shown triggering Boogie Woogie by clapping Mahito's hand with his own. [ 28 ] Boogie Woogie: Revised  ( 不義遊戯  ( ブギウギ )  改  ( かい )  ,   Bugi Ugi Kai ? ) : After losing his left hand and replacing it with a  vibraslap , Todo changed the condition for activating Boogie Woogie from a clap to a metal piece hitting a wooden box. This allows him to perform approximately 50 swaps per second, if necessary. [ 29 ]  Through a binding vow, the range and targets of his technique may also be expanded if the number of swaps per strike on the vibraslap is limited. [ 30 ] Anti-Domain Techniques 
 
 
 
 New Shadow Style: Simple Domain  ( シン・ 陰  ( かげ )  流  ( りゅう )  「 簡  ( かん )  易  ( い )  領  ( りょう )  域  ( いき )  」 ,   Shin Kageryū: Kan'i Ryōiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that disables a  domain expansion 's sure-hit effect within its area by neutralizing its barrier. Todo learned this technique from  Yuki Tsukumo . [ 31 ]

Overall Skill : Arata Nitta is a first-year student and a non-combatant type of jujutsu sorcerer. He doesn't appear to have much experience but his technique makes him useful on missions despite his lack of combat ability. Arata has knowledge of basic first aid and any type of healing techniques are extremely rare among jujutsu sorcerers, making him a highly valuable asset. While Mechamaru made it so most of the Kyoto students would stay away from Shibuya for their own safety, he was confident that Arata would be helpful during the incident. [ 8 ] Innate Technique 
 
 
 
 
 Pain Killer : This technique allows Arata to stop existing injuries from getting any worse. Arata can't heal wounds but he can stop bleeding and reduce the pain for anyone he applies it to. However, any injuries sustained after the technique's application are unaffected. [ 9 ]   (Unnamed)

Overall Skill Level : Despite not possessing an innate technique, Kusakabe is a respected grade 1 sorcerer and a master swordsman of the New Shadow Style.  Mei Mei  regarded Kusakabe as the only sorcerer of his grade to make that rank without an innate technique. [ 6 ]  According to her,  Kento Nanami  and Gojo, Kusakabe is the strongest grade 1 sorcerer, though Gojo specified that this statement may not be accurate if sorcerers from the  Big Three Families  were to be taken into account. [ 7 ] Despite such praises, Kusakabe openly admits on several occasions he has no chance of defeating a special grade and avoids them at all costs. However, he is fully confident he can defeat other adversaries such as the curse users  Toshihisa Negi  and  Manami Suda , who he considered below his level. [ 8 ] While several jujutsu sorcerers in training were fighting to get  Prison Realm  from Kenjaku, Kusakabe intervened just in time to save the lives of all his allies. Kenjaku even commented on Kusakabe's knowledge on New Shadow Style, seemingly out of respect for his skill. [ 9 ] Master Swordsman : Kusakabe's swordplay is his main weapon in battle, relying heavily on physical prowess. In combination with the swordsmanship techniques of the New Shadow, he has showcased high proficiency in wielding his blade. Using  Batto Sword Drawing , Kusakabe made short work of three curse user henchmen in an instant. [ 10 ] New Shadow Style Techniques 
 
 
 
 New Shadow Style: Simple Domain  ( シン・ 陰  ( かげ )  流  ( りゅう )  「 簡  ( かん )  易  ( い )  領  ( りょう )  域  ( いき )  」 ,   Shin Kageryū: Kan'i Ryōiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that neutralizes a  Domain Expansion 's barrier and disables its sure-hit effect within its range. Kusakabe used Simple Domain to weaken Sukuna's  Dismantle , reducing the damage of the slashes done to him. [ 11 ] Batto Sword Drawing  ( 抜  ( ばっ )  刀  ( とう )  ,   Battō ? ) : A fast sword drawing technique that coats Kusakabe's blade in cursed energy and rotates it around the blade to increase its drawing speed dramatically, enough so to make it the fastest iai-sword drawing technique of the New Shadow Style.
 
 
 
 
 Evening Moon Sword Drawing  ( 居  ( い )  合  ( あい )  「 夕  ( ゆう )  月  ( づき )  」 ,   Iai・Yūzuki ? ) : Another sword-drawing technique with a different stance than Batto Sword Drawing that activates a Simple Domain. By incorporating an original program into the Simple Domain, Kusakabe can automatically intercept anything that enters the Simple Domain with his katana. [ 12 ] 
 
 
 
 
 Hazy Moon  ( 朧  ( おぼろ )  月  ( づき )  ,   Oborozuki ? ) : A New Shadow Style technique that recreates part of a broken blade with cursed energy. [ 13 ]
